info.title: RGB++ Indexer API
info.description:
RGB++ state indexed from CKB, reconciled against Bitcoin.

Amounts and capacities are decimal strings, since a u128 UDT amount does not survive a JSON number. CKB hashes are `0x`-prefixed; Bitcoin txids are bare hex in display order.

get.summary: Liveness. Answers as long as the process is serving.
Index progress, lag, and derived counts.
get.description:
`ckb.blocks_behind` is the window between the chain tip and what is queryable.
Only the endpoints that reconcile against Bitcoin can see into it.

get.summary:
Findings that need a human: Bitcoin spends with no CKB transition, and
commitments that do not match.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description:
`btc_spent_without_ckb`, `no_commitment_in_spender`, `commitment_mismatch` or
`unknown_btc_tx`. Absent for all.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, clamped to the configured maximum.

get.summary: RGB++ history for a Bitcoin address, newest first.
get.description:
Deliberately does not reconcile against the Bitcoin data source: history is
settled, and the indexed range already lags the tip by `REORG_LAG` by design.
A very recent transition appears here a few minutes after it confirms; use
`/v1/rgbpp/transactions/{btc_txid}` to watch one in flight.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Bitcoin address on the network this index follows

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, clamped to the configured maximum.

400.description: Not a valid address on the network this index follows

get.summary: Every distinct asset the index has seen, by type script hash.
get.description:
Grouped over the cell table on read, like every other aggregate here. There is no
name: a type script hash is an asset's whole identity here. There is no holder
count either. `live_seal_count` counts distinct Bitcoin outpoints holding the
asset, which overstates holders whenever one address holds several.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description:
`udt` (xUDT + sUDT), `dob` (Spore and Spore Cluster), `unknown`, or `all`.
Absent means `all`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, clamped to the configured maximum.

get.summary: RGB++ cells held by a Bitcoin address.
get.description:
Reconciles by default: the address's live UTXO set is fetched from the Bitcoin data
source and diffed against the index, and anything that has moved is re-observed,
so the answer reflects Bitcoin even when the CKB side lags. Pass `reconcile=false`
to answer from the index alone.

An empty `cells` list does not distinguish "holds nothing" from "not indexed yet";
check `/status` while the index is catching up.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Bitcoin address on the network this index follows

parameters.name: reconcile
parameters.description: Diff against the Bitcoin data source before answering. Defaults to `true`.

parameters.name: include_spent
parameters.description: Include cells already consumed on CKB.

400.description: Not a valid address on the network this index follows

502.description: Bitcoin data source or CKB node unavailable; safe to retry

get.description:
Re-observes the outpoints the Bitcoin transaction spends, and looks past the
indexed range by asking the rich indexer directly for cells bound to its outputs,
so `resolution` can report a transition the index has not reached yet. Suitable
for polling.

parameters.name: txid
parameters.description: Bitcoin txid, hex, display order

502.description: Bitcoin data source or CKB node unavailable; safe to retry

get.summary: Most recent RGB++ state transitions, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, clamped to the configured maximum.

get.summary: One RGB++ state transition by CKB transaction hash.

parameters.name: tx_hash
parameters.description: CKB transaction hash, `0x`-prefixed

fee.description:
Satoshis. Null when the transaction has not been observed yet, or when the
data source does not report a fee.

ActivityCellDto.description: A cell an address gained or lost.

oneOf.description:
`None` when the transition has no resolved Bitcoin side — issuance, or a
transaction whose txid could not be derived from its outputs.

cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to continue after this entry.

next_cursor.description: Null when the page reached the end of the history.

unresolved_bindings_total.description:
Bindings anywhere in the index whose owning address is still unresolved.

Deliberately global, not per-address: a binding with no known owner cannot be
attributed to *this* address either, so a per-address count would always be
zero and would say nothing. Non-zero means the backfill is still running and
any history may be incomplete — better than presenting a partial list as the
whole story.

oneOf.description:
What the diff against the Bitcoin data source turned up. Present unless
reconciliation was skipped.

AddressReconcileDto.description: Outcome of diffing an address's live UTXO set against the index.

contradicted.description:
Recorded as spent by the index, still listed as unspent by the data source —
a replaced transaction or a Bitcoin reorg.

disappeared.description: Believed live by the index, no longer listed by the data source.

source_utxo_count.description: Outpoints currently unspent according to the Bitcoin data source.

AssetDeltaDto.description:
Net change in one asset, from this address's point of view.

Computed here rather than left to the caller: every client would otherwise
reimplement the same signed sum over received minus sent, and a history row that
says "−100 TOKEN" is the whole point of the endpoint.

amount.description: Signed decimal string. Null for non-fungible assets.

AssetDto.description:
One distinct asset in the index.

There is no `symbol` and no `decimals` field, and there will not be one until
something indexes the cells that publish them: the type script hash is the whole
identity of an asset here. A client that needs a name has to resolve it itself.

live_seal_count.description: Distinct Bitcoin outpoints currently holding it.

total.description: Distinct assets of this kind in the whole index, for paging.

after.description: Bitcoin confirmations `btc_txid` needs before the cell unlocks.

oneOf.description: Lock the cell falls back to once `after` is met.

amount.description: UDT amount as a decimal string. Null for non-fungible assets.

asset_kind.description:
`xudt`, `sudt`, `spore`, `spore_cluster`, `unknown` (a type script matching
no configured code hash) or `none` (no type script).

oneOf.description: Present for RGB++ locks. BTC time locks reference a transaction, not a UTXO.

status.description:
`live`, `pending_ckb` (bound UTXO spent on Bitcoin, CKB transition not
indexed yet) or `spent`. Derived from the CKB fact and the Bitcoin
observation together.

blocks_behind.description:
Blocks between the chain tip and what is queryable — the size of the window
that only the on-demand path can see into.

CountsDto.description: Derived counts, computed on every request.

udts.description: Distinct UDT type script hashes seen under an RGB++ lock.

tx_index.description:
`-1` means the cell was backfilled from the node, where the position inside
the block is not reported.

ErrorResponse.description: Every error response has this shape.

changed.description: Whether this observation differs from what the indexer previously held.

synchronous.description: Wait for the refresh instead of queueing it.

ScriptDto.description:
A CKB script as stored with the cell.

Documentation only: the field it describes is passed through as stored JSON, but
always has exactly this shape.

oneOf.description: Never observed, or the observation has been invalidated.
Spent by a transaction still in the mempool.

SpendStatusDto.description: What the Bitcoin data source last said about one outpoint.

StatusDto.description:
What `/status` reports. Deliberately explicit about the lag: an application that
does not know how far behind the indexed range is cannot tell "not there" from
"not there yet".

oneOf.description: The Bitcoin data source has never heard of this transaction.
Seen on Bitcoin; no CKB transaction found yet.

Cells for this transaction exist on CKB above the indexed range: the
transition is real, the index has not reached it yet.
A CKB transition is indexed for this Bitcoin transaction.

TransitionResolutionDto.description: Where an RGB++ transaction has got to, across both chains.
